body.text: How many daily flights connect IST/SAW to AYT?

Roughly 25 to 35 daily non-stop flights connect Istanbul's two airports to [Antalya Airport (AYT)](https://www.antalya-airport.aero/passengers-visitors/transportation) in winter, climbing above 40 daily flights from May through October. Turkish Airlines runs hourly-style frequencies from IST, while [Pegasus Airlines](https://www.flypgs.com/en/domestic-flights) and [AJet](https://ajet.com/en-tr/flights-from-istanbul-to-antalya) cover high-frequency departures from SAW alongside select IST slots.

Flight time averages 1 hour 15 minutes, making same-day business meetings, medical consultations, or weekend golf trips straightforward. Because Antalya Airport operates separate domestic and international terminals linked by a free inter-terminal shuttle, check your boarding pass terminal code before ordering a pickup—domestic arrivals exit quickly onto the kerbside pickup lane and the AntRay tram platform.
Which airlines offer the best baggage allowance for resort or golf gear?

For travellers bringing full-size resort suitcases or Belek golf bags, [Turkish Airlines](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-int/any-questions/sports-equipment/golf/) offers the clearest domestic sports-equipment policy. On Turkish Airlines domestic flights, one golf set up to 23 kg carries a flat 850 TRY transport fee (free for Miles&Smiles Elite Plus members), and international connecting itineraries include the first golf set free through December 31, 2026 with mandatory advance reservation.

Low-cost fares on [Pegasus Airlines](https://www.flypgs.com/en/pegasus-baggage-allowance) and AJet work well for cabin-only weekenders, as standard domestic fares permit one 8 kg cabin bag (55×40×23 cm on Pegasus). However, once you add a 20 kg checked suitcase plus sports equipment fees, comparing the total door-to-door fare against Turkish Airlines' ExtraFly or PrimeFly domestic bundles often narrows the price gap considerably.
How long does AYT to Kaleiçi, Lara, Belek or Kemer take?

Airport transfer times from [Antalya Airport](https://www.antalya-airport.aero/yolcu-ve-ziyaretciler/ulasim/otobusler-ve-toplu-tasima) depend on whether your hotel sits east (Lara, Belek) or west (Kaleiçi, Konyaaltı, Kemer) of the runways. Lara resorts are only 20 to 25 minutes away, Kaleiçi takes 25 to 35 minutes by car or AntRay tram, Belek takes 35 to 45 minutes, and Kemer runs 55 to 70 minutes along the coastal D400.

body.text: Note that Kaleiçi's historic pedestrian streets restrict vehicle entry; taxis and vans drop guests at gates such as Hadrian's Gate or Karaalioğlu Park unless your boutique hotel arranges an access permit.
When is driving via Bursa and Pamukkale worthwhile?

Driving the ~700-kilometre inland route from Istanbul to Antalya via the Osmangazi Bridge, Bursa, Afyon or Denizli/Pamukkale takes 8 to 9 hours non-stop and is rarely worthwhile as a single-day sprint. It becomes rewarding when you have 3 to 4 days to spare, overnighting in Bursa for Ottoman heritage and Uludağ views, then continuing to [Pamukkale and Hierapolis](https://www.muze.gov.tr/muze-detay?DistId=PMK&SectionId=PMK01) before descending to Antalya.

items: Reserve golf bag space with Turkish Airlines at least 48 hours ahead so aircraft hold limits do not block check-in.
Use the AntRay tram from AYT Domestic Terminal if staying near Kaleiçi with light wheeled luggage; choose a private van for Belek or Kemer.
Confirm your hotel's exact Belek or Kemer district name (e.g., Kadriye vs Boğazkent, Göynük vs Tekirova), as resort zones span 15–20 km.

Factor in the 2026 [Osmangazi Bridge toll](https://www.kgm.gov.tr/SiteCollectionDocuments/KGMdocuments/Otoyollar/OtoyolKopruUcret/2026Gecis_Ucret/2_OSMANGAZ%C4%B0_BRIDGE_ENG.pdf) (1,170 TL for Class 1 cars) if driving south via Bursa.

faq.q: Does the AntRay tram run directly from Antalya Airport to Kaleiçi?
faq.a: Yes. The AntRay T1A tram departs directly outside Antalya Airport's domestic terminal and reaches central stops near Kaleiçi (such as İsmetpaşa and Muratpaşa) in roughly 35 minutes.

faq.q: How much does Turkish Airlines charge for a golf bag from Istanbul to Antalya?
faq.a: On domestic Turkish Airlines flights, one golf set up to 23 kg costs 850 TRY (free for Elite Plus members), and advance reservation entry is mandatory.

faq.q: Is it faster to fly from IST or SAW to Antalya?
faq.a: Flight time is nearly identical (75 minutes) from both airports; pick IST if staying on Istanbul's European side and SAW if staying on the Asian side.

faq.q: How far is Belek from Antalya Airport for golf groups?
faq.a: Belek's main golf resorts lie 33 to 40 kilometres east of AYT, taking 35 to 45 minutes in a private transfer van with room for multiple golf travel covers.

faq.q: Can I drive from Istanbul to Antalya in one day?
faq.a: Yes, the ~700 km highway drive is possible in 8 to 9 hours via Bursa and Afyonkarahisar, though most travellers prefer flying unless stopping overnight in Bursa or Pamukkale.

faq.q: Are Havaş airport buses available from AYT to Kemer or Belek?
faq.a: Havaş shuttles serve central Antalya (up to 5M Migros in Konyaaltı) rather than Belek or Kemer resort hotels; for those zones, book a private transfer or rent a car at AYT.
